title: Unit 29 Consolidation: the neoliberal reforms
goal: Consolidate the ideas, the privatisations, the changing role of the state, inequality and the legacy of the 1990s.
grammar: review: relative clauses, ser passive, contrast connectors, aunque, opinion verbs

items: I can retell the main steps of the neoliberal reforms and the debate about them.
I can use the words for reform, privatisation, trade and inequality in sentences.
I can describe people and ideas with relative clauses and say what was sold with the *ser* passive.
I can contrast gains and costs with *sin embargo*, *no obstante* and *aunque*.
I can say what defenders and critics believe with *creen que* and *no creen que*.
